defects_found_and_fixed.what: truncated the scan at `now` converted to ET unconditionally; the MNKD frame is Tokyo-clocked, a 13-hour error
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: truncate on the frame's own clock; naive frames keep the ET assumption
defects_found_and_fixed.found_by: reading the code while wiring the sleeve - the same one-keystroke family that once overwrote 1,050 frozen NKD bars

defects_found_and_fixed.what: judged candidate entry stamps as bare wall-clock text against the ET slot band; the committed NKD rows are stamped +09:00 in the Tokyo session window
defects_found_and_fixed.measured_impact: 26 of the replay's NKD rows silently rejected; accepted tail 91 -> 67
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: SESSION_WINDOWS/SESSION_WINDOW_CLOCKS in track1_params; _hhmm_on converts aware stamps to the window's clock; live NKD candidates carry the aware Tokyo stamp
defects_found_and_fixed.restored: replay tail 91, reject_window 0, pinned by a full-replay test

defects_found_and_fixed.what: hard-required the ET clock of every frame; the Tokyo frame was refused tz_mismatch
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the check accepts the requirement's own declared clock and still refuses a WRONG clock without converting

dst_note: the ET slot band equals the Tokyo session band in summer only; in winter the late ET slots fire after the session window closes and the gate refuses them TOO_LATE. That drift is legacy's own fixed-ET cron behaviour, inherited deliberately - fixing it would be a rule change dressed as plumbing
